role: Git pre-commit hook (activated by `make setup-hooks` → scripts/install-git-hooks.sh setting core.hooksPath=.githooks). Blocks a commit on SwiftLint errors, on a SwiftLint run that did not complete, or on missing SwiftLint; reports SwiftLint warning count and staged-file SwiftFormat drift advisory only; blocks a commit while any code-map record is missing or stale, or while the code-map tooling is not installed.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail. (1) If `swiftlint` is not on PATH → fail() with install instructions for the portable SwiftLint 0.65.1 zip, the version ci.yml pins (commit blocked). (2) Creates a temp file for SwiftLint's stderr (mktemp failure → fail()), with an EXIT trap removing it. Runs `swiftlint lint --config .swiftlint.yml --quiet` capturing stdout and its exit status; greps stdout lines containing ": error:". If the status is neither 0 nor 2, or is 2 with no error lines, prints the captured stderr and fail() saying SwiftLint did not complete (blocked). If error lines exist → prints them and fail() (blocked). (3) Counts ": warning:" lines; reads .ci/swiftlint_warning_budget.txt (falls back to "?" if unreadable); if the count is not "0", prints "N warnings (budget B), 0 errors" — never blocks on warnings. (4) If `swiftformat` is on PATH: lists staged .swift files (git diff --cached --diff-filter=ACM); if any, runs `swiftformat --lint` over them NUL-separated; a non-zero exit only prints a "not blocking" note. If swiftformat is missing, prints a skip note. (5) If .venv-codemap/bin/python is not executable → fail() telling the developer to run `make codemap-setup` (commit blocked). Otherwise runs scripts/check_codemap.sh with that interpreter; a non-zero exit (problems listed by the check) → fail() pointing to docs/codemap/README.md (commit blocked). The check reads the working tree, not only the staged content, so unstaged edits to code or records also count. Writes nothing in the repository. Bypass: git commit --no-verify. Assumes SwiftLint's exit codes: 0 = no error-severity violation, 2 = error-severity violations.

units.does: Prints a blank line, "pre-commit: <message>", and a blank line to stderr, then exits 1, aborting the commit.
units.entry: Called by the hook body when swiftlint is missing (line 39) or reports errors (line 58); the hook itself is run by git before each commit.
